package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for request_context_value_extraction_duplicated_across_handlers: Repeated current-user, tenant, locale, or auth extraction logic.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

func GetOrdersHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	userID := r.Context().Value("user_id").(string)
	tenant := r.Context().Value("tenant").(string)
	locale := r.Context().Value("locale").(string)
	fmt.Fprintf(w, "orders for user=%s tenant=%s locale=%s", userID, tenant, locale)
}

	locale := r.Context().Value("locale").(string)
